top_signals.title: PHP shares mitigation for new RCE vulnerability with no patch
top_signals.summary: The PHP security team has shared mitigation measures for a new remote code execution vulnerability that affects systems with non-default configurations and has no patch. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.
